ZHDC Delhi Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ZHDC Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ZHDC Delhi Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts at Zakir Husain Delhi College is scheduled for 12 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: Zakir Husain Delhi College has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) in History.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) positions are as per UGC Regulations 2018 for Assistant Professor of Colleges. Specific details for the History post are also as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly cap of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ZHDC Delhi Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if any, category certificate if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.
